'''B8-M2''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], B8-M2 was stationed deep in [[the Tomb]] guarding one of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] teleporters, and served as a communications link to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vorel]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
B8-M2 appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is part of the Bonus Series for Imperial players.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
